}}'''Mil Tesen''' is a peddler.{{ref/book|c|Mil Tesen|comp}}

==Appearance and personality==
He has a grizzled face and a floppy hat. He refers to himself as "old Mil".{{ref/book|6|p}}

He claimed to not be afraid of the [[Aiel]] in Cairhien and in fact he expressed a wish to meet some as they trade well with peddlers and he believes they have a lot of gold to spend after raiding the city.{{ref/book|6|p}}

== Activities ==
[[Gawyn Trakand]], [[Jisao Hamora]], and other [[Younglings]] encountered Mil north of the city of Cairhien while he was travelling with the embassy from [[Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower]] to [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Cairhien]].{{ref||comp}}{{ref/book|6|p}}

Mil told Gawyn that his mother [[Morgase Trakand]] was dead and the Dragon Reborn had taken most of Andor. Gawyn grabbed him and questioned him further. Mil heard the Dragon Reborn killed Morgase and potentially the [[Daughter-Heir]] [[Elayne Trakand]], but he wasn't sure about the latter. Angry, Gawyn dismissed the peddler and asked Jisao to "deal with him." Although only rumor, Gawyn believed it could turn out to be true and vowed to revenge their deaths on the Dragon Reborn if so.
